bibl.title: Readings in Antiphon's Truth (POxy 1364).
bibl.seg: Mark Baldock, Readings in Antiphon's Truth (POxy 1364).
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XI, 1364 (= MP3 92; LDAB 230). A feature of the scribe, not noted by the editors, is his reluctance to let lines run under-length. Critical notes based on this "paleographical principle".
